name: DonutChart
usage: The same uses as PieChart, when a ring fits the layout better

props.name: data
props.description:
The items. Colors follow the position in this array (or `slot`), so hiding or folding items never changes
the color of the others.

props.name: maxSlices
props.description:
Most slices drawn: beyond it, the largest `maxSlices - 1` items are kept and the rest are folded into
"Other" (muted color). The table view still lists every item. At most 8.

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the tooltip and the table.

props.name: nameLabel
props.description: Header of the name column of the table view, "Category" by default (follows `locale`).

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Header of the value column of the table view, "Value" by default (follows `locale`).

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.

props.name: description
props.description: A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at
this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous
graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives.

props.name: error
props.description: Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range).

props.name: plain
props.description: Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer.

types.name: PieChartDatum
types.summary: A slice of a pie or donut chart.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the item in the legend, the tooltip and the table; shown as text, never interpreted as HTML.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value; zero, negative and missing values draw no slice but are listed in the table.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: Pins the color of the item to a position of the categorical palette (by default its position in `data`).

types.name: ValueFormat
types.summary:
How a value is written.
- `'auto'`: in full below 10,000, compact from 10,000 on (1,284 · 12.9K · 4.2M).
- `'number'`: always in full, with grouping separators.
- `'compact'`: always compact.
- `'percent'`: the value is a ratio (0.125 → 12.5%).
- a function: your own formatting (units, currencies).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
The same as a pie chart, drawn as a ring. Slices are separated by a 2 px gap and carry no numbers: the legend,
the tooltip and the table do.
